claims_boundary: This score is a fail-closed internal evidence/fit gate. It must not be represented as a statistical probability of fixing Boeing or Spirit enterprise problems unless calibrated against sufficient partner-authorized outcomes. Public sources define a bounded target problem; synthetic tests do not establish production effectiveness, savings, defect reduction, certification, airworthiness, or adoption.

hard_caps.reason: No measured effect against an agreed baseline.
No independent review of partner evidence and analysis.
